units.CD7101-lubumbashi: Lubumbashi, capital of Haut-Katanga and the DRC's second city, is firmly state-held and far from the eastern conflict zones. Day-to-day order in its communes (Lubumbashi, Kampemba, Kenya, Kamalondo, Katuba, Rwashi, Annexe) is kept by the PNC, which since April 2025 runs the anti-crime 'Operation Ndobo' and, with FARDC, periodic cordon-and-search operations against urban bandits (2025-2026). Urban crime (armed robbery, groups of young bandits, sometimes involving rogue soldiers/police) is significant but no gang holds territory. The secessionist Bakata Katanga militia has staged sporadic raids on the city (latest major attack Feb 2021, some 2024 incidents) but holds no ground. FARDC (22nd military region HQ) and Republican Guard (Kimbembe camp) are garrisoned in the city. Peri-urban villages of Annexe commune (Kafubu and Kipushi health zones) have no reported armed-group activity and are assessed as default PNC presence.
